This approach simplifies referrals, reduces administrative burden and ensures members are connected to the appropriate support without delay. Please note the reasons for referral include non-medical assistance (e.g., New Medicaid enrollee, navigating benefits, financial and/or social support). Referral Form Comagine Health Provider Portal The Comagine Health Provider Portal is a web-based application for electronically submitting utilization management review requests. Getting Started: Register Get started by registering to use the Comagine Health Provider Portal. Complete the appropriate forms in the registration packet and email or fax them to Comagine Health. We will contact you after we receive your registration packet.
